snapshot.text: Compulsory health insurance system with a mix of public and private providers. In 2026 new rules favouring public hospitals worried the private sector, and a plan to send newly graduated doctors to rural areas drew criticism.

priorities.title: Linking health and social care
priorities.text: The minister's stated goal is better cooperation between the healthcare and social welfare systems.

priorities.title: Hospital pharmacies for cheaper medicines
priorities.text: The minister wants hospital pharmacies so that medicines become cheaper for patients.

priorities.title: Hospital resilience as security
priorities.text: Investment in hospital infrastructure is framed as part of Europe's security.
